messages:
Maria (Growth): Quick sync — prelaunch SEO checklist for the webinar + launch post. Need: keyword boarding, event/schema snippets, internal-link sweep, and redirects mapping. Target: publish next Wed. :calendar:
AJ: Can you post the top 5 priority keywords here? I can wire them into meta + hero copy once we lock them. :mag:
Maria (Growth): Top 5 (prelim): 
- 'production LLM inference'
- 'low-latency model serving'
- 'LLM inference platform'
- 'model serving cost optimization'
- 'private inference deployment'
Linking doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx (internal) — added keyword boarding table.
Lucy M: For the webinar page, do we want full Event JSON-LD + FAQ schema? or just Event + breadcrumbs?
Maria (Growth): Event JSON-LD + FAQ for the registration page. Breadcrumbs for the post. Keep FAQ short (3 Qs). I'll draft copy for the FAQ.
Samir K: Redirects: we should map any old campaign URLs -> canonical launch page. Quick example (nginx):
```
rewrite ^/old-webinar-signup$ /webinar/2026-04-registration permanent;
rewrite ^/old-launch-blog$ /blog/2026-04-launch permanent;
```
Also add 301s in our redirect spreadsheet.
Ryan T: I'll run an internal-link sweep and output a list of orphaned pages. Will use the crawler then grep for low-click anchors. Command I use: `pa11y-ci --reporter html` + `python scripts/link_sweep.py --site staging.redwood.ai`
Maria (Growth): Assignments: 
- AJ: update hero/meta once keywords locked
- Lucy: JSON-LD + FAQ draft by EOD Tue
- Ryan: internal-link sweep + CSV to marketing by Tue noon
- Samir: redirects spreadsheet + nginx rules PR by Tue EOD
I'll compile everything into the launch playbook doc.
AJ: small nit — for 'production LLM inference' should we prefer 'production-grade LLM inference' in H1? which tests better?
Maria (Growth): Good call. Use 'production-grade' in H1, keep the shorter variant in meta description.
seo-bot: Crawl summary: 12 pages flagged for duplicate titles on /blog and /docs. See report: https://internal/seo/reports/2160043200 (auto)
Lucy M: Posting sample event JSON-LD in case helpful:
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T16:00:00-07:00",
  "location": {
    "@type": "VirtualLocation",
    "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/register"
  },
  "description": "Demo + benchmarks: running LLM inference at scale with low latency and predictable costs.",
  "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" }
}
</script>
```
Samir K: Also make sure GA event tags + UTM mapping are in the redirect landing pages. I added one example row to the spreadsheet: `?utm_source=partners&utm_campaign=webinar_apr26`
Maria (Growth): Great. Can we get a quick content QA on the FAQ for accuracy (runtime claims + SLA language) before publishing? Tagging @Ryan T for runtime fact-check.
Ryan T: I'll verify runtime/latency claims against the perf deck and flag any overstated numbers.
AJ: I'll draft two meta variants for A/B testing (short vs. descriptive). Put them in the doc.
Maria (Growth): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. I'll do a pre-publish sweep Wed morning and coordinate the redirect deploy with EngOps. :rocket:
